session_and_routing.route_guards: Protect panel dashboard routes. Unauthenticated users redirect to role-specific login screen.
session_and_routing.logout_behavior: Clears ll_auth_v1 session token and returns to panel's login screen without destroying underlying demo business fixtures.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.data_testid_rule: All interactive buttons, links, form inputs, error notices, demo credential toggles, and headers MUST include data-testid attributes for E2E validation.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.accessibility_rule: Ensure clear visible focus rings on inputs, contrast ratios over 4.5:1, and keyboard navigable forms.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the landing page at root URL '/' displaying the persistent banner and 2-column ecosystem grid.
Do NOT alter or redesign existing dashboard routes and layouts; wrap existing routes with session guard higher-order components or Context providers.
Integrate namespaced local storage auth state ('ll_auth_v1') pre-seeded with judge demo accounts.
Ensure input fields are styled with large touch targets (min-h-[48px]) and inline validation feedback.
Attach data-testid attributes to all form controls, cards, error text, and logout triggers.
